applies_if.value_text: rental unit is covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance eviction provisions

rules.penalty: Unlawful eviction may expose the landlord to substantial civil and/or criminal liability.
rules.title: Just cause required for evictions
rules.requirement: In units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, a landlord can only evict you for one of 17 listed just-cause reasons. The lease simply ending or a change in owner is not a just cause.
rules.requirement_es: En unidades cubiertas por la Ordenanza de Alquiler de San Francisco, el propietario solo puede desalojarlo por una de 17 causas justas enumeradas. El simple vencimiento del contrato o un cambio de dueño no es causa justa.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units covered by the Rent Ordinance, including newer units (certificate of occupancy after June 13, 1979) and Costa-Hawkins units that are exempt from rent increase limits.
rules.quote: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.
